item.title: Sarvam Maya Kerala Box Office 3rd Friday: Nivin Pauly's film enters 3rd weekend with good spike, grosses Rs 1.75 crore on Day 16
item.description: Sarvam Maya collected Rs. 1.75 crore on its third Friday, according to estimates. The movie registered a spike of roughly 15 per cent while entering the third weekend. The running total of Sarvam Maya has now reached Rs. 61.30 crore gross at the Kerala box office in its 16 days of theatrical run. The movie is expected to see more spikes on Saturday and Sunday, which will take its third weekend to around Rs. 5.50 crore to 6 crore. item.description: Dhurandhar collected Rs. 5.25 crore nett approx on its sixth Saturday, returning to record daily collections after missing out for a day on sixth Friday. item.description: The Raja Saab collected Rs. 28 crore approx at the Indian box office on Saturday, taking its two-day total box office collections to Rs. 94 crore approx.
